This is a verification-capability/harness blocker, not RTL failure evidence.

board_tb.sv is explicitly missing. functional_sim=fail is therefore an aggregate prerequisite failure: VCS, its analyzer, AXI/DDR diagnostics, and deadlock checks were not run and cannot support a liveness, value, ordering, AXI, DDR, or numeric diagnosis.

The prior repair-execution record is only ready_to_apply. Its r6 proposal is constrained to source-bound probe selection while preserving the wrapper, adapter, certified kernel, AXI model, artifacts, target-model output, and numeric policy; it is not evidence that the change was applied or passed.

The historical VCS diagnosis reporting zero accepted output beats is marked historical_only and lacks a current source-bound applicability binding. It must not direct a kernel repair; a fresh current-candidate replay is required after harness gates pass.

Live lower-layer certificates remain reusable: operator-leaf certificate sha256 2bbc6880205155cbc1119882b2503281c2cb43b4b3c0d40a1754acb1e3a20569 and single-layer certificate sha256 44d3689d835f165fd30e794aeec2dabf648d1d65d17a24a53d3a6aac6e3854e7. No current trace contradicts them. The connected kernel is an elastic variable-latency token pipeline; unequal same-token stage timing is not itself a failure.

sacg_memory_truth authoritatively lists 10 active same-scope contamination barriers and 4 open same-scope retry requests, with no open same-scope backtrack request. Rejected Stage7/Stage8 artifacts are planning/debug inputs only and cannot be promoted or consumed as validated evidence.
proposed_actions: Apply only the prepared r6 source-bound board testbench/instrumentation revision and complete the missing exact-board multilayer loader/harness closure without altering semantic inputs, target outputs, numeric policy, wrapper sources, or lower-layer RTL.
Rerun the fresh board-interface-discovery and multilayer-pipeline gates against the candidate hashes. Do not invoke VCS until both gates pass.
After entry gates pass, execute a current exact-wrapper AXI/DDR boundary replay and analyze direct lifecycle/output progress, ordering, deadlock, and target-model numeric comparison.
If that replay fails, localize the earliest causal board boundary before proposing a repair. Do not reopen certified lower layers unless the trace meets the named contradiction standard.

Only after all board gates pass may a fresh semantic-evidence artifact be assembled and the active retry/barrier lineage be reconciled; no backend, bitstream, runtime, or board promotion is authorized now.
risks: A tensor manifest alone does not prove DUT consumption. The repaired candidate must bind every required Transformer-block tensor for every target layer through the actual loader/harness and demonstrate hashes at the DUT boundary.

Model/checkpoint, stimulus, target reference, comparison tolerance, or semantic testbench-contract drift would invalidate comparison evidence. Expected outputs must continue to come from target-model inference on the identical immutable input and checkpoint.

A board wrapper or VCS compile-plan mismatch can create a false integration result. The exact sample-project wrapper, simulation sources, and Vivado-export authority must be hash-bound before execution.
AXI or prefetch activity alone is not output/lifecycle progress. Any future frontier stall requires fresh boundary evidence and does not preselect a wrapper, kernel, or RTL root cause.

The active rejected source-identity lineage and current discovery status must be reconciled by a fresh content-addressed discovery rerun; neither stale rejection nor a summary-level pass is promotion evidence.
Reopening leaf or connected-kernel verification without the required direct contradictory current trace would discard live certified knowledge and violate the hierarchical repair loop.

constraints: Transformer-block scope only; exclude embedding/tokenization, final norm, LM head/logits, and sampling from DUT weight coverage and golden boundaries.
Keep checkpoint, stimulus, target-model outputs, numeric policy/tolerance, semantic testbench contract, and exact board-wrapper hashes immutable.
Use the exact user-supplied sample-project wrapper and its discovered source/Vivado-export hashes; do not substitute a simplified wrapper or guess an integration target.
Retain certified lower layers unless a fresh hash-bound board trace directly contradicts a named invariant with core start, ingress, egress, causal-boundary, and certificate evidence.
Treat the 10 active same-scope contamination barriers and 4 open same-scope retry requests as downstream-consumption blockers until a fresh, content-addressed passing board candidate is reconciled.

case_multilayer_pipeline pass -> case_axi_ddr_interface and VCS eligibility -> multilayer/AXI/deadlock/DDR gates -> board semantic evidence
fresh current-layer trace -> CCTG localization -> bounded current-layer repair or explicitly evidenced lower-layer contradiction
